display.purpose: Campaign headlines and public hero statements. Never inside a form.

title.purpose: Dialog titles, card and workspace section headings.

body.purpose: Running copy and form values; 65-75ch measure on public and parent surfaces.

label.purpose: Form labels, buttons, navigation, column headers.

shadows.name: raised

shadows.name: overlay

shadows.name: scrim

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing; stronger than Tailwind's default so entrances move in the frame the user is watching.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a screen wants. Harbor Teal fill, white label, darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--primary, oklch(0.499 0.086 219.2)); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 14px/1 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised, 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), scale .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, oklch(0.42 0.086 219.2)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.35 0.063 219.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.35 0.063 219.2)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { scale: 0.96; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary one. Neutral surface, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--background, #fff); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 500 14px/1 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised, 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 1px 3px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.08)); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.35 0.063 219.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.35 0.063 219.2)); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible action. A tinted red surface, never a solid red slab.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)); font: 500 14px/1 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive, oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Persistent label above a hairline-bordered field. Placeholders never replace labels.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 14px/1 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 400 14px/1.5 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.556 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.35 0.063 219.2)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--background, #fff), 0 0 0 4px var(--ring, oklch(0.35 0.063 219.2)); }

narrative.overview:
A registrar is the person at the desk who has done this a thousand times and is still glad you came. They tell you where you are, what is missing, and what happens next - without ceremony, without making you feel slow, and without pretending a problem is smaller than it is. Every screen in this system is that person.

The system is Islamic and principled, warm and reassuring, capable and disciplined, aspirational, contemporary, local and human. It is not a technology company. Teal carries hierarchy, orange appears rarely and deliberately, surfaces stay flat and honest, and typography does the structural work.

The registers differ by application, not the system: parent admission calm and forgiving, committee administration dense and status-led, public profiles expressive, campaigns energetic. The family resemblance comes from typography, spacing, voice and color logic.
keyCharacteristics: Warm authority: never bureaucratic, never salesy
Two elevations only - raised controls, floating overlays; borders carry structure, not depth
Teal for hierarchy, orange for rare warmth, neutral for everything else
One typeface across welcoming public copy and compact operational tables
Status is always legible: never color alone, never an icon alone
Bahasa Indonesia, Latin script only - no Arabic-script UI anywhere

rules.name: The Rare Orange Rule
rules.body: Ember Orange is emphasis, never state. Never the error color, never a status fill, never a default button.

rules.name: The Two-Teal Rule
rules.body: Harbor Teal acts; Madina Teal identifies. If it can be clicked it is Harbor. If it is the brand being recognised it is Madina.

rules.name: The Never-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every status carries a word. Color, icon and position are reinforcement.

rules.name: The School-Color Containment Rule
rules.body: A school's primary colors its own public profile. It never recolors payment, validation or workflow state.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans covers every register. No second typeface, no decorative display face, no icon font.

rules.name: The No-Shouting Rule
rules.body: No uppercase paragraphs, no wide letter-spacing runs, no weights below 400 for text a parent must read on a phone.

rules.name: The Latin-Only Rule
rules.body: Applications render no Arabic-script text: no Arabic typeface, no RTL layout, no Arabic content fields.

rules.name: The Three Questions Rule
rules.body: Every screen answers: where am I, what is the current state, what should I do next.

rules.name: The URL-Owns-State Rule
rules.body: Anything that should survive a refresh or be shared lives in the address. Never a hidden active child in the session.

rules.name: The Nothing-Is-A-Pill Rule
rules.body: Fully rounded shapes are reserved for genuine badges. Buttons, inputs and cards keep the radius scale.

rules.name: The No-Emblem-Watermark Rule
rules.body: Detailed school emblems are never enlarged as background watermarks or fragmented into decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Step Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two elevations: raised and overlay. A third step is a design change, not a component decision.

rules.name: The Depth-Is-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A border that only fakes depth is a shadow written wrong. Borders stay for dividers, structure, selection and focus.

rules.name: The Nothing-Lifts-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Hover changes color. Elevation describes what a surface is, not what the pointer is doing.

dos: Do put every status into words. Color is reinforcement, never the message.
Do darken on hover (Harbor Teal Deep), never fade a brand fill with opacity - bg-primary/80 drops white text to 3.89:1.
Do keep Ember Orange rare and decorative-free.
Do use tabular numerals for dates, fees and counts.
Do hold WCAG 2.2 AA in every state, and let accessibility beat exact color fidelity when the two conflict.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: opacity survives, everything that travels or scales stops.
Do keep committee density and parent calm as differences in spacing, not two component libraries.
Do match icon stroke to the weight of the text beside it - 1.75 next to medium (500) labels.
Do end every error with a way out: a retry, a link, or both.
Do grow the control when a target needs to be bigger; an invisible overlay extending past a control steals clicks from whatever it covers.
Do use the touch size (44px) on parent-facing surfaces and the compact scale (24-36px) for committee and CMS work.
donts: Don't ship an Arabic typeface, RTL layout, or Arabic-script content field.
Don't use continuous motion - no shimmer, pulse, spinner or blur loop.
Don't put white text on Madina Teal or Ember Orange.
Don't invent the deferred tokens: warm neutrals, semantic colors, chart ramp, school primaries.
Don't sample a color from a compressed raster logo and call it official.
Don't let a school's color escape its profile site into workflow state.
Don't place three equal school logos in one header, or shorten an identity to just "Madina".
Don't add gradients, glass, or decorative pill chrome. Shadows are the two tokens and nothing else.
